title: AAPS 2.8.2 Automation tabs says obj 11 not started
body:
I was 1 day away from finishing obj 10 when I ticked the box to show the Automation tab. It came with an initial "Low" automation. I had a look at it but didn't do anything else.

When I activated obj 11, I came back to this tab and the lower part is full of lines _Obj 11 not started_. There are so many lines that I couldn't even scroll till the end...

![20210326_224317](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/112711326-d5b55900-8ec7-11eb-99b4-0050198f0987.jpg)

comments.body:
When I set an SMS and Annotation action, the generation of the line seemes to have stopped.

Maybe it would be better to put an example that sets an _annotation_ and not an _action_ in order not to generate these lines x million times.

It would be nice to be adle to delete these lines too.

![Screenshot_20210327-092412_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/112715370-1620d100-8ee0-11eb-844d-aa4546eb29df.jpg)

Ok, quiting the app clears the list so almost all seems ok. 

The tab would be improved by not putting an _action_ as first example programming.
